name: Ouro Preto
tagline: Baroque gold-rush town in the hills of Minas
summary: Ouro Preto was the capital of Brazil's 18th-century gold rush, and its steep cobbled streets are crowded with Baroque churches gilded with that gold. See the work of the sculptor Aleijadinho, go down an old gold mine, and pair the trip with the astonishing open-air art park of Inhotim.
seasonNote: Dry season (April to September) is best; Carnival here is wild.
arrival: About 2 hours by bus from Belo Horizonte.
gettingAround: Walk (very steep); taxis to mines and Mariana.
cashTip: Cards and Pix work almost everywhere; carry some reais for beach vendors. A 10 percent service charge is usually added.
foodTip: Comida mineira: pão de queijo, feijão tropeiro, frango com quiabo and doce de leite.

connections.note: Fly to Belo Horizonte, then 2 hours by road.
